cases.description: The retained headless suite exactly as WO-07 left it (388 cases: every pre-WO-08 test, WO-08 cases excluded by name), rerun after the WO-08 engine changes (Renderer2D material bucket + observation counters, Circle shaders, UiSystem image UVs, Camera2DController input policy, RendererAPI::FinishGpu, GpuObjectStats hooks).

The six pre-WO-08 2D golden cases (sprites, tilemap, light2d, light2d A/B, ui, scene2d) through the wrapper's before/after SHA-256 of tests/render/goldens: the 14 original goldens must be byte-unchanged and no .actual/.diff diagnostics may appear.
